entry.title: AI Content Research & Blogpost Writing Assistant - RUNNER H
entry.summary:
This is a submission for the Runner H "AI Agent Prompting" Challenge An AI-powered Content Research & Blog Writing Assistant using Runner H. It: Accepts a blog topic Finds recent articles from reliable sources Summarizes their key points Writes a unique, well-structured blog post Formats it in Google Docs, ready to publish No plugins, no code — just one prompt and full automation. 📄 Google Doc Output – Iran-Israel Conflict https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZPTmnTVuLXPoTfuqsEW-FJJS-U59-IhtUwhgPHU1OCA/edit?usp=sharing Here’s what the prompt did: Asked for a blog topic Researched 5 recent articles online Extracted summaries from each Wrote an original 800–1000 word blog post Structured it with:
Title
SEO Meta Description
H2 subheadings
Bullet points
CTA
Formatted it into a styled Google Doc and shared the link All of this was handled by Runner H with no manual work beyond inputting the topic. Ask the user to enter a blog topic (e.g., "Top AI tools for productivity"). Then: Search the web for 5 recent high-quality blog articles on the topic (past 6 months). Use sources like Medium, Google, HubSpot, etc. For each article, extract: Title Author/source 1–2 sentence summary Link Using insights from all 5 articles, generate a unique, original blog post (800–1000 words), including: Blog Title SEO meta description Introduction 3–5 H2 subheadings Bullet points (if helpful) Conclusion with a CTA Format the blog into a clean Google Doc titled:
Use: Font: Roboto or Arial, 12pt Bold subheadings Clean spacing and short paragraphs Share the Google Doc link with the user.
Important: Do not copy content — summarize and rephrase based on insights. This is perfect for: Content creators Solo founders Bloggers Students doing essays Marketing teams needing scalable content It saves 3–5 hours per blog post and helps produce consistent, high-quality writing that’s SEO-friendly. Made by: Meet Gohel (@meet_gohel_9f2ee9a5349695)
Solo project using just AI prompting and Runner H. Let’s build smarter, not harder 🧠🚀

While blockchain technology offers transparency and immutability, the security of your funds ultimately rests on the strength and management of your private keys. One of the most critical, yet often overlooked, security practices is key rotation. What is Key Rotation and Why is it Crucial? Mitigating Compromised Keys: Even with the best security practices, keys can be compromised through phishing attacks, malware, insider threats, or accidental exposure. Regular rotation limits the damage a compromised key can inflict, as its validity period is inherently shortened.
Preventing Long-Term Exposure: The longer a key is active, the greater the window of opportunity for attackers to find vulnerabilities or brute-force their way in (though highly improbable for strong keys, it's a risk).
